value.body: Payroll executives make sure employees are paid correctly and on time, with tax and social-security deductions handled as the law requires. Companies, payroll outsourcing firms and CA firms hire them. Each month follows a cycle: collect attendance and changes, run payroll, check it, pay, and file returns.

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Payroll software, Excel, Income Tax, EPFO and ESIC portals

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually join a payroll outsourcing firm, a CA firm or a company's HR or finance team as payroll associates. Knowledge of salary TDS, provident fund and ESI rules is the main thing interviewers check.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: PF, ESI and professional tax rules

value.title: At a glance
items: The work is deadline-driven around month-end and tax filing dates.
Labour codes and tax rules change, so keeping up is part of the job.
Next steps: payroll lead, compensation and benefits, or HR operations.
